army_rules.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
army_rules.rules_text:
The Thousand Sons are wreathed in the energies of the Warp. It is the gift of their sorcerous leaders to channel this power through battlefield ritual, to divine forbidden knowledge, to weave illusory magicks or to ravage their foes with empyric fire and mutation.

If your Army Faction is THOUSAND SONS, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals from those listed below. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test for that model by following the sequence below.

Psychic Test Sequence: Roll 2D6. You can then Channel the Warp (optional) and roll one additional D6. Then, if one or more double or triple results were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.

options.name: Destiny's Ruin
options.rules_text: Warp Charge 5. Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 10+, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

options.name: Destiny's Ruin - Empowered
options.rules_text: Psychic test result 10+. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

options.name: Temporal Surge
options.rules_text: Warp Charge 6. Select one friendly THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. That unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 10+, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead. In either case, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

options.name: Doombolt
options.rules_text: Warp Charge 7. Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 11+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds instead.

options.name: Doombolt - Empowered
options.rules_text: Psychic test result 11+. Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. That enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

options.name: Twist of Fate
options.rules_text: Warp Charge 9. Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 12+, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.

options.name: Twist of Fate - Empowered
options.rules_text: Psychic test result 12+. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2.

army_rules.name: Pact of Sorcery
army_rules.rules_text:
The daemons of Tzeentch are drawn through the barriers of the Warp by rituals of transmutation.

When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select SCINTILLATING LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

rule.name: Kindred Sorcery
rule.rules_text: In your Command phase, you can select one of the abilities listed below to take effect until the start of your next Command phase. You can only select each of these abilities once per battle. Imbued Manifestation: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army. Psychic Maelstrom: Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll. Wrath of the Immaterium: Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

options.name: Imbued Manifestation
options.rules_text: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army.

options.name: Psychic Maelstrom
options.rules_text: Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.

options.name: Wrath of the Immaterium
options.rules_text: Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

enhancements.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. Each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving that Ritual, add 6" to its range.

enhancements.name: Incandaeum
enhancements.rules_text: EXALTED SORCERER model only. Once per battle, when selecting a Ritual for the bearer to attempt, you can select Doombolt, even if a model from your army has already attempted to manifest that Ritual this phase.

enhancements.name: Umbralefic Crystal
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. Once per battle, per army, in your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do: Place this unit in Strategic Reserves. This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase. This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

enhancements.name: Eldritch Vortex of E'taph
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

stratagems.name: Psychic Dominion
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

stratagems.name: Destined by Fate
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.
stratagems.target: That PSYKER model.
stratagems.effect: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.

stratagems.name: Egotistical Power
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can use the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.

stratagems.name: Desecration of Worlds
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Arcane Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a THOUSAND SONS model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).
stratagems.target: That THOUSAND SONS model.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).

stratagems.name: Devastating Sorcery
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

detachments.name: Changehost of Deceit

rule.name: Infernal Pacts
rule.rules_text: SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army have the following ability: Daemonic Illusions (Aura): While a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is within 6" of and visible to this unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. THOUSAND SONS units from your army have the following ability: Mortal Sorcery (Aura): While a friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS PSYKER unit is within 6" of and visible to this unit, that SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

additional_rules.name: Restrictions
additional_rules.rules_text: You can include SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units in your army, even though they do not have the THOUSAND SONS Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is: Incursion: Up to 500 pts. Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts. Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts. No SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

restrictions: SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units can be included even though they do not have the THOUSAND SONS Faction keyword.
Incursion: Up to 500 points of SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units.
Strike Force: Up to 1000 points of SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units.
Onslaught: Up to 1500 points of SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units.
No SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

enhancements.name: Nethershrike Mind-Eater
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
restrictions: THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only.

enhancements.name: Diabolic Savant
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

enhancements.name: Duplicitous Malediction
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three THOUSAND SONS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.
restrictions: THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only.

enhancements.name: Tome of True Names
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 2+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Sulphurous Veil
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Depraved Clamour
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible SCINTILLATING LEGIONS targets for those attacks.

stratagems.name: Ethereal Phantasm
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS units.

stratagems.name: Fractal Disjunction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Chronosorcerous Bleed
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER/SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Glimmershift Portal
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army (excluding MONSTERS), or one SCINTILLATING LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice
rule.rules_text: Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot or fight and one or more TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED units from your army are selected as a target of one or more of those attacks, each of those TZEENTCH MUTANT units can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Each time a TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, before selecting its targets, that unit can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

additional_rules.name: Keywords
additional_rules.rules_text: TZANGORS units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword and, while such a unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of TZANGOR models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Warpmeld Dagger
enhancements.rules_text: TZANGOR SHAMAN model only. Each time the bearer attempts a Ritual, just before determining the Psychic test result, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds; if it is not destroyed as a result, add 1 to that Psychic test result for each of those mortal wounds suffered.

enhancements.name: Diamond of Distortion
enhancements.rules_text: TZANGOR SHAMAN model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Bray Lord
enhancements.rules_text: SORCERER or INFERNAL MASTER model only. The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability.
restrictions: SORCERER or INFERNAL MASTER model only.

enhancements.name: Flowing Flesh
enhancements.rules_text: TZANGOR SHAMAN model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability and a Wounds characteristic of 5.

stratagems.name: Gift of Change
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER model from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, add one TZEENTCH CHAOS SPAWN unit containing one model to your army, and set it up as close as possible to where your model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Warped Vicissitude
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TZANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Deranged Ferocity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That TZEENTCH MUTANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", and when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in it that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

stratagems.name: Blessed Transmutations
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army, and one friendly TZANGORS unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 12" of that PSYKER model.
stratagems.effect: Return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTERS) to your TZANGORS unit.

stratagems.name: Touched by Tzeentch
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Twisted Mirage
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, or anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units if it is a MONSTER unit. In either case, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

rule.name: All Is Dust
rule.rules_text: When gathered in significant numbers, empyric eddies gust around the eerily silent Rubricae, reinforcing the sorcerous shackles that bind their spirits to their armour. So empowered, the Thousand Sons' battle-brothers become nigh invulnerable. The rune-etched sarcophagus of their battle plate must be hacked apart piece by piece before the unquiet spirit within submits. Each time an attack with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to a RUBRICAE model from your army, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

enhancements.name: Risen Rubricae
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select either two RUBRICAE BATTLELINE units from your army or one other RUBRICAE unit from your army, models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

faq.question: While using the Rubricae Phalanx Detachment, if I attach a CHARACTER to a unit selected using the Risen Rubricae Enhancement, does that CHARACTER also gain the Infiltrators ability?

enhancements.name: Arcane Thralls (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While a friendly RUBRICAE unit is within 9" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Rubricae
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a RUBRICAE model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: The Stave Abominus
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS D3] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

stratagems.name: Ardent Automata
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a RUBRICAE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That RUBRICAE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One RUBRICAE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance rolls made for it, and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: Infernal Fusillade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and a Strength characteristic of 5.

stratagems.name: Revenge of the Rubricae
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One RUBRICAE unit from your army that was within 6" of that PSYKER model when it was destroyed.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your RUBRICAE unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target the enemy unit that just destroyed your PSYKER model (and only if it is an eligible target).

stratagems.name: Implacable Guardians
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit (excluding PSYKER models), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Unwavering Phalanx
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One RUBRIC MARINES unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rule.name: Warpfire Infusion
rule.rules_text: Each time a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, apply one of the following when resolving those attacks: If that VEHICLE unit is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll. Otherwise, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll. Each time a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed while it is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models, that model's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 5+ instead of only a 6.

enhancements.name: Warp Synch
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, after you roll that additional D6 but before checking for doubles or triples, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one of those VEHICLE units; that VEHICLE unit suffers 1 mortal wound and you can re-roll that additional D6.

enhancements.name: The Perplexing Cloak
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability.

enhancements.name: Biomechanical Mutation
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. In your Command phase, you can select one friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model within 6" of this model. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Warp-Cursed Runemaster
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units, each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving that Ritual, add 6" to its range.

stratagems.name: Hex-Marked Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Mutate Landscape
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker is mutated, and remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. While an objective marker is mutated and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Cyberspirit Machinations
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6" of that VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Malevolent Animus
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your VEHICLE unit is malevolent. While a unit is malevolent, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

stratagems.name: Ensorcelled Infusion
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, and that is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Warpflame Gargoyles
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit must then take a Battle-shock test.

rule.name: Sorcerous Invigoration
rule.rules_text: Once per turn, per unit, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit (excluding MONSTER units) successfully manifests a Ritual, that unit heals D3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Eruption of Vitality
enhancements.rules_text: INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model only. Once per battle, per army, when this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an Attached unit and its unit has a Starting Strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining.
restrictions: Infantry/mounted Thousand Sons Psyker Model Only.

enhancements.name: Curse of Life
enhancements.rules_text: INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model only. When this model heals as a result of the Sorcerous Invigoration detachment rule, you can add 3 to the number of wounds healed.
restrictions: Infantry/mounted Thousand Sons Psyker Model Only.

stratagems.name: Relentless Rebirth
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Mutagenic Magicks
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.

rule.name: Flow of Magic
rule.rules_text: Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army's Flow of Magic, as follows: Your deployment zone is always within your army's Flow of Magic. At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man's Land, until the end of that phase, No Man's Land is within your army's Flow of Magic. At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent's deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent's deployment zone is within your army's Flow of Magic. Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes a Psychic Attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If such a model is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, each time it makes a Psychic Attack, add 1 to the Wound roll instead.

options.name: Flow of Magic
options.rules_text: Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes a Psychic Attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

options.name: Flow of Magic - Empowered
options.rules_text: While wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes a Psychic Attack, add 1 to the Wound roll instead.

enhancements.name: Arcane Might
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit. While the bearer is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in that unit instead.

options.name: Arcane Might - Flow of Magic
options.rules_text: While the bearer is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in that unit instead.

enhancements.name: Empowered Manifestation
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer's unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, you can add 6" to the range of Psychic abilities the bearer has that specify a range (including Rituals) and each time a model in the bearer's unit takes a Hazardous test for a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Empyric Onslaught
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Noctilith Mantle
enhancements.rules_text: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, it is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic. Models in that unit cannot be selected to use any Rituals.

stratagems.name: Warding Hex
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Doomed
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Strands of Time
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Through the Veil
stratagems.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One RUBRIC MARINES or SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.effect: If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATOR unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
restrictions: If a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Scouring Warpflame
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has shot this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Kaleidoscopic Tempest
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth. If your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, your unit has -3" detection range.

wargear_options: Any number of models can each have their Tzaangor blades replaced with 1 autopistol and 1 chainsword.
1 Tzaangor not equipped with a herd banner can be equipped with 1 brayhorn.
1 Tzaangor not equipped with a brayhorn can be equipped with 1 herd banner.
equipment: Every model: Tzaangor blades.

abilities.rules_text: Deadly Demise D6

abilities.name: Assault Ramp
abilities.rules_text: Each time a unit disembarks from this TRANSPORT after it has made a Normal move that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 186) for that disembarkation.

wargear_options: This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 inferno combi-bolter; 1 inferno combi-weapon.
This model can be equipped with 1 havoc launcher.
equipment: 2 soulshatter lascannons; twin inferno heavy bolter; armoured tracks.
units.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 14 THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 models.
units.damaged: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Siege Shield
abilities.rules_text: When making ranged attacks with its demolisher cannon, this model can target enemy units within Engagement Range of it (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, when making ranged attacks, this model does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

units.name: Defiler

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Deadly Demise D6

abilities.name: Scuttling Walker
abilities.rules_text: Each time this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

abilities.name: Destroyer of Futures (Once per phase, per unit)
abilities.rules_text: You can target this unit with the Counter-offensive Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. That use is -1CP. That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

wargear_options: This model's Hades battle cannon can be replaced with 1 ectoplasma destructor.
This model's excruciator cannons can be replaced with 2 pyraflux magma cutters.
This model's heavy baleflamer can be replaced with one of: 1 Hades lascannon; 1 heavy reaper autocannon; 1 electroscourge (a model cannot be equipped with more than one electroscourge).
This model's heavy missile launcher can be replaced with one of: 1 Hades lascannon; 1 heavy reaper autocannon; 1 electroscourge (a model cannot be equipped with more than one electroscourge).
equipment: 1 Hades battle cannon; 2 excruciator cannons; 1 heavy missile launcher; 1 heavy baleflamer; 1 shearing claws.

units.name: Forgefiend

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Deadly Demise D3

abilities.name: Ablazing Salvoes
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

wargear_options: This model's 2 Hades autocannons can be replaced with 2 ectoplasma cannons.
This model's Forgefiend jaws can be replaced with 1 ectoplasma cannon and 1 Forgefiend claws.
equipment: 2 Hades autocannons; Forgefiend jaws.

units.name: Helbrute

abilities.name: Core
abilities.rules_text: Deadly Demise 1

abilities.name: Terrifying Assault
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase and the Fight phase, after this model has shot or fought, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if it is within 9" of one or more THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units from your army.

abilities.name: Devoted to Destruction
abilities.rules_text: If this model is equipped with two melee weapons in addition to its close combat weapon, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those two weapons.

wargear_options: This model's multi-melta can be replaced with one of: 1 Helbrute plasma cannon; 1 twin autocannon; 1 twin inferno heavy bolter; 1 twin lascannon; 1 Helbrute fist.
This model's missile launcher can be replaced with one of: 1 Helbrute fist; 1 Helbrute hammer; 1 power scourge.
For each Helbrute fist this model is equipped with, it can be equipped with one of: 1 inferno combi-bolter; 1 heavy flamer.
equipment: Missile launcher; multi-melta; close combat weapon.

If you do: this unit can re-roll that charge roll; this unit must end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that friendly PSYKER unit.
